title: North Korean remote IT staffer worked for US government agency, says FBI
summary: The FBI is reportedly investigating how a North Korean was hired to work for a U.S. federal government agency. The official confirmed to Federal News Network that the FBI is investigating a North Korean working for an unnamed federal agency.
